name: zgeometry_weiler_classify_adjacent_edge_pair_against_contour_segment
description: zGeometry_Weiler::ClassifyAdjacentEdgePairAgainstContourSegment classifies an adjacent two-edge corner against a contour segment.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has documented x87/HLIL limitations around the side-value sign-test chain. Assembly is the accepted behavior evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x469450 validates the adjacent link check, first/second side tests against the contour segment, crossing return 7, and side-of-adjacent-pair returns 1 and 2.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies the crossing return, the positive-side return, and the negative-side return.
